name: SPT-CL J2254-4620 (Hubble)
blurb: SPT-CL J2254-4620, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: sptclj22544620-hubble
story: A massive galaxy cluster found by the South Pole Telescope, which spots such clusters by the faint change their hot gas makes in the brightness of the cosmic microwave background.

claims.text: SPT-CL J2254-4620 is a galaxy cluster detected in the SPT-SZ survey
The SZ effect is a change in the cosmic microwave background's brightness toward clusters, caused by hot gas
